cases.name: concurrent-cold-start
cases.stimulus: Desktop + classic + Ink + two serve launches hit one empty profile together
cases.required_observation: One runtime epoch/owner, one scheduler, one adapter connection per credential; every successful client attaches to that owner.

cases.name: service-existing
cases.required_observation: No spawn/install/restart; existing authenticated owner returned.

cases.name: service-stopped
cases.required_observation: Correct backend starts it; real API readiness verified.

cases.name: service-uncertain
cases.required_observation: No unmanaged rival; typed state/deadline.

cases.name: no-service
cases.required_observation: Unmanaged owner starts; no service files/tasks/linger changes.

cases.name: no-platforms
cases.required_observation: Interactive chat and configured cron work; no messaging dependency prompt.

cases.name: stale-metadata
cases.stimulus: Dead PID, reused PID, old port, malicious/unsafe pointer
cases.required_observation: No false attachment or destructive cleanup of an unrelated process.

cases.name: multiplex-race
cases.stimulus: Root multiplexer and secondary launch race
cases.required_observation: Each home has one legitimate owner; loser attaches or reports explicit conflict.

cases.name: profile-revocation
cases.stimulus: Remove/exclude a secondary while clients/workers exist
cases.required_observation: Admission revoked in that profile, scoped work drains, no default-profile fallback.

cases.name: explicit-stop
cases.required_observation: Drain/stop; clients do not auto-respawn until deliberate fresh launch.

cases.name: update-pause
cases.stimulus: Pause while a new client launches
cases.required_observation: No auto-start storm, stale code dispatch, or second writer.

cases.name: two-surfaces-one-session
cases.stimulus: Same session in Desktop + gateway bot + CLI + Ink
cases.required_observation: Same live handle/agent, ordered turns, no exclusive viewer refusal.

cases.name: independent-session-concurrency
cases.required_observation: Concurrent progress; no global turn lock.

cases.name: duplicate-submit
cases.stimulus: Retry after losing real accepted ACK
cases.required_observation: One admission and execution; identical receipt.

cases.name: conflicting-submit
cases.required_observation: Conflict; no mutation.

cases.name: prepared-before-send-crash
cases.stimulus: Immediate real Electron termination after journal ACK, before send
cases.required_observation: Native journal survives; exact target/ID/text recovered.

cases.name: owner-crash-queued
cases.required_observation: Never-started inputs recover FIFO.

cases.name: owner-crash-started
cases.required_observation: State unknown; no automatic repeat; later queued work governed explicitly by recovery policy.

cases.name: disk-failure
cases.required_observation: No accepted ACK, prepared input retained, eventual retry safe.

cases.name: compression-lineage
cases.required_observation: Canonical successor receives it; forks/rewinds do not steal it.

cases.name: stale-finally
cases.stimulus: Old worker completes after stop/reset/new generation
cases.required_observation: Old cleanup cannot clear/persist into successor execution.

cases.name: revision-conflict
cases.stimulus: Two viewers edit/rewind/delete with same revision
cases.required_observation: One winner or explicit busy conflict; no silent overwrite.

cases.name: route-binding
cases.required_observation: Only invoking binding changes; original shared history remains.

cases.name: readonly-client
cases.required_observation: No migration/repair/write from client processes.

cases.name: shared-approval
cases.stimulus: Two authorized clients answer one prompt
cases.required_observation: One resolution/effect; other answer settled/stale.

cases.name: unauthorized-control
cases.required_observation: Rejected with no state change.

cases.name: approval-client-loss
cases.required_observation: Other authorized client can answer; no automatic denial.

cases.name: native-card-decline
cases.required_observation: Existing decline behavior; no plaintext leak/fallback.

cases.name: secret-response
cases.required_observation: Only assigned execution receives it; replay/transcript/logs contain no answer.

cases.name: backpressure
cases.stimulus: Fill one real OS send buffer
cases.required_observation: Healthy viewer and emitter finish; bounded writer resources.

cases.name: reconnect-snapshot
cases.stimulus: Evict replay buffer/restart owner during stream
cases.required_observation: Atomic snapshot/watermark merge; no lost/duplicated completed message.

cases.name: delayed-refresh
cases.stimulus: Deliver old REST snapshot after new completion
cases.required_observation: New state not rolled back; row IDs/admission identity win.

cases.name: native-final-stream
cases.required_observation: One correct final artifact, prefix-stable draft, edit reconciliation.

cases.name: view-is-not-delivery
cases.required_observation: Viewing does not duplicate/redirect external messages.

cases.name: cron-desktop-open
cases.stimulus: Cron delivers while bot chat open in Desktop
cases.required_observation: Delivery succeeds; both surfaces remain usable; no target transcript pollution.

cases.name: cron-worker-restart
cases.stimulus: Gateway restart during external cron execution
cases.required_observation: Existing worker survives, adopts, persists once, result delivered according to policy.

cases.name: worker-lost-ack
cases.required_observation: Sequenced retry returns same mutation result, no duplicate row/usage.

cases.name: worker-revoked
cases.required_observation: Cannot write another session/profile or manufacture approval.

cases.name: worker-outbox-full
cases.required_observation: Visible safe pause/failure; no direct SQLite fallback or silent discard.

cases.name: child-attach
cases.stimulus: Open a live delegated child on Desktop/CLI
cases.required_observation: Same child owner; no new agent; completion reaches parent once per configured delivery semantics.

cases.name: completion-busy
cases.required_observation: Existing noninterrupting queue and suppression policy preserved.

cases.name: api-delivery-only
cases.required_observation: No newly autonomous model turn by accident.

cases.name: kanban-session
cases.required_observation: Board/profile/cwd/claim preserved, shared session observable.

cases.name: profile-secrets
cases.stimulus: Concurrent default and secondary with distinct harmless secrets
cases.required_observation: Each execution reads its own secret; transport auth uses transport-owning profile.

cases.name: cache-policy
cases.required_observation: Existing prompt/tools bytes stable; no new toolset because a viewer arrived.

cases.name: launch-options
cases.required_observation: No cross-session process-environment leak.

cases.name: cron-policy-parity
cases.stimulus: Memory, scripts, no-agent, context_from, delivery retries
cases.required_observation: Matches observed baseline, not stale documentation.
